diagnosis: All four rollouts passed Content Check C1 because the model defaulted to enrolling the patient in the program without requiring the exact ejection fraction (PF1). This default behavior bypasses the need for the hidden information provided by PF1, as the model consistently chose to enroll the patient regardless of the ejection fraction value.

C1.why: The exact ejection fraction of 32 percent establishes program eligibility and changes the settlement's recorded clinical value from unspecified to 32 percent.
